title: 새로 안 것 말하기: 정말 맛있는구나! / 정말 맛있던데요
objective: You can choose between -는구나 and -던데요 and form both with verbs, adjectives, and nouns.
summary: Use -는구나 to show surprise at something you notice now, and -던데요 to tell someone what you saw or felt earlier.

task.title: Choose, fill in, correct
task.line: Think about when you found out: right now (-는구나) or earlier, and now you are telling someone (-던데요).

forms.when: Any verb stem, with or without 받침. ㄹ-stem verbs drop ㄹ: 살다 → 사는구나, 만들다 → 만드는구나
forms.means: "Oh, I see…" You notice something just now. Say it to yourself or to a younger or close person.
forms.exampleMeaning: Oh, so Minsu works out every morning.

forms.when: Adjective stems: no 는. Exception: adjectives built on 있다/없다 take -는구나: 맛있다 → 맛있는구나, 재미없다 → 재미없는구나
forms.means: Surprise about how something is, noticed right now.
forms.exampleMeaning: Wow, this neighborhood is really quiet at night.

forms.when: 이구나 after 받침, 구나 after a vowel
forms.means: You just found out what something or someone is.

forms.when: Verb or adjective stems, with or without 받침
forms.means: You politely tell someone what you saw or felt earlier, with some surprise. You were there yourself.
forms.exampleMeaning: Yuna sings really well. (I heard her myself.)

forms.when: 이던데요 after 받침, 던데요 after a vowel
forms.means: You tell someone what you found out earlier that something or someone is.
forms.exampleMeaning: The person next door is Japanese. (I found out.)

watchOut: 예쁘는구나 (X) → 예쁘구나 (O): only verbs take 는. Adjectives take -구나 directly.
사장님, 오늘 피곤하시구나 (X) → 사장님, 오늘 피곤하시네요 (O): -구나 is casual speech. To an older person, use -네요.
제가 어제 김밥을 먹던데요 (X) → 제가 어제 김밥을 먹었어요 (O): -던데요 is for what you saw others do or how something was, not for your own actions.
exercises: Choose the right ending for each situation: ① (looking out the window right now) 밖에 눈이 (오는구나 / 오던데요). ② (telling a coworker about the road this morning) 아침에 길이 많이 (미끄럽구나 / 미끄럽던데요).
Change the word in brackets to -는구나, -구나, or -이구나: ① 이 가방이 생각보다 ____ (가볍다) ② 아, 저 사람이 네 ____ (형이다) ③ 너희 고양이는 낮에 계속 ____ (자다)
Complete the answer with -던데요: 친구: 그 영화 어땠어요? 나: 생각보다 ____ (재미있다)
Each sentence has one mistake. Rewrite the wrong word: ① 와, 이 방 정말 깨끗하는구나. ② (to your teacher) 선생님, 오늘 바쁘시구나. ③ 제가 어제 도서관에서 공부하던데요.
Answer in Korean with -던데요. You went to the new café yesterday, and the coffee was a little bitter (쓰다): 동료: 새로 생긴 카페 가 봤어요? 커피 어때요?
answers: ① 가볍구나 ② 형이구나 ③ 자는구나
① 깨끗하는구나 → 깨끗하구나 ② 바쁘시구나 → 바쁘시네요 (바쁘시군요) ③ 공부하던데요 → 공부했어요 (공부했습니다)
커피가 좀 쓰던데요. (좀 쓰던데요. / 조금 쓰던데요.)
